en: The porcelain committee approves.
zh: 瓷器委员会一致通过。

en: Your throne has found its hero.
zh: 王座终于等到英雄了。

en: These pipes deserve a tiny parade.
zh: 给水管办个迷你庆功会。

en: The bowls are holding their applause.
zh: 马桶们正憋着掌声呢。

en: The restroom just took a deep breath.
zh: 洗手间终于松了口气。

en: The plunger is taking the afternoon off.
zh: 皮搋子下午放假啦。

en: A royal flush awaits your command.
zh: 皇家冲水，等你一声令下。

en: Even the tiles look impressed.
zh: 连瓷砖都看呆了。

en: Your pipes just earned a gold star.
zh: 水管喜提一朵小红花。

en: The queue has stopped writing complaints.
zh: 排队的人终于收起投诉信。

en: You made porcelain problems look easy.
zh: 瓷器难题，被你轻松拿下。

en: The toilet brush wants your autograph.
zh: 马桶刷排队找你签名。

en: The plumber is asking you for tips.
zh: 水管工也来向你取经了。

en: That was a very moving performance.
zh: 这场表演，流畅得很。

en: The cistern saved you a front-row seat.
zh: 水箱给你留了贵宾席。

en: A clean sweep starts with one big whoosh.
zh: 再来一声哗啦，漂亮收工。

en: The pipes have formed your fan club.
zh: 水管后援会正式成立。

en: Your bathroom budget is now mostly confetti.
zh: 洗手间经费全换成彩纸啦。

en: The bowls are ready for their victory lap.
zh: 马桶们准备绕圈庆功。

en: This throne room runs on good decisions.
zh: 这座王座厅，靠你来调度。

en: The clog has left the group chat.
zh: 堵塞已退出群聊。

en: The plumbing union requests a snack break.
zh: 水管工会申请加餐。

en: Your next promotion comes with a lid.
zh: 下次升职，自带马桶盖。

en: The water is practicing its dramatic exit.
zh: 水花正在排练华丽退场。

en: A standing ovation would suit this seat.
zh: 给这张座位来个起立鼓掌。

en: The mop brought popcorn for the finale.
zh: 拖把抱着爆米花等收尾。

en: The toilet roll is rolling out the carpet.
zh: 卫生纸正忙着铺红毯。

en: Those rubber gloves deserve a cape.
zh: 橡胶手套也该披上披风。

en: The bath mat is doing its happy shuffle.
zh: 地垫正跳着开心小碎步。

en: Your pipes are finally on speaking terms.
zh: 水管们终于聊到一块儿了。

en: A little teamwork goes a long U-bend.
zh: 齐心协力，U形弯也让路。

en: The drain is clearing its throat.
zh: 下水口正在清嗓子。

en: You taught these bowls some table manners.
zh: 你把马桶教得彬彬有礼。

en: The porcelain orchestra is ready.
zh: 瓷器交响乐团准备就绪。

en: The pipes have no more plot twists.
zh: 这回水管不演反转了。

en: The rubber duck is taking notes.
zh: 小黄鸭已经掏出笔记本。

en: Your toilet has better timing than my alarm.
zh: 这马桶的节奏比闹钟还准。

en: Please accept this imaginary golden seat.
zh: 请收下这只想象中的金座圈。

en: The squeaky hinge just sang your praises.
zh: 吱呀作响的铰链也夸你。

en: All aboard the express to Whooshville.
zh: 开往哗啦镇的快车就位。

en: The elbow pipe is giving you a thumbs-up.
zh: 弯头水管正给你竖大拇指。

en: This seat has never seen such ambition.
zh: 小小座位，见识了大志向。

en: The water meter is counting happy moments.
zh: 水表开始记录快乐时刻。

en: That deserves a tasteful splash of pride.
zh: 这份骄傲，值得溅一点水花。

en: The bathroom mirror sees a legend.
zh: 洗手间镜子里，站着个传奇。

en: Even the loose screw is holding it together.
zh: 连松动的螺丝都稳住了。

en: The soap insists it helped.
zh: 肥皂坚持说自己也有功。

en: Your next opponent is the empty paper roll.
zh: 下一位对手：空纸筒。

en: The maintenance log just added a smiley.
zh: 维修日志里多了个笑脸。

en: One button stands between us and whoosh.
zh: 离一声哗啦，只差一个按钮。
